scope: Bounded read-only review of R14 against R13, R6, R8, R9 and foundation R1/R2. No source, test, Git, UI, model, runtime or dispatch action.

r13_open_decisions.evidence: R14 freezes one private _RetainedResourceSet in _CodeSession, an immutable origin plan, ordered eleven _RetainedResource records, a private compiled CodeProofResources context, graph registration before acquisition, completion only after all acquisitions/compilation, active-only wrappers, and finalization/reverse cleanup before clearing references.

R14 freezes file stamp (st_dev, st_ino, st_mode, st_size, st_mtime_ns, st_ctime_ns, st_nlink), no-follow named stat, first fstat equality, repeated named/fstat/descriptor-byte checks, directory dev/inode/type/mode comparison, and deterministic absent/unsafe/stat/open/read/pin outcomes with R8 group/error precedence and WORK_PATH_UNSAFE override.

R14 names required O_* flags, supports_dir_fd/supports_follow_symlinks/supports_fd checks, callable descriptor primitives, bounded os.scandir(fd), all private syscall seams (_getcwd, _open, _stat, _fstat, _scandir, _read, _seek, _mkdir, _write, _link, _unlink, _fsync, _flock, _dup, _close), and flock/fsync errno mapping.

consistency_checks: R14 keeps foundation pure: no filesystem authority, descriptor ownership, public identity, derivation or public wire behavior is moved into the two-file foundation increment.
R14 preserves R6/R8 single retained graph, no-follow descriptor-relative operations, final lineage precedence, bounded scans and no legacy loader/path fallback.
R14 preserves R9 public command/error and output rules as later integration obligations; it does not claim implementation or dispatch.
R14’s eleven-resource count matches foundation R1/R2’s ten schemas plus one profile.
boundary: Preparation review only. R14 is suitable input to a later exact I/O freeze after independent review; implementation, adversarial tests, source/wheel checks, Linux CI and acceptance remain future gates, not findings against the three R13 closures.
